SUSPENSION AND AXLE – REAR DIFFERENTIAL

Proper Contact Pattern

Forward                                                    Reverse

SA1125

If tooth contact pattern is not correct, replace the adjusting
washer installed on the front of the drive pinion rear bearing
to adjust it.
NOTICE: Be sure to always use a new part when replac-
ing adjusting washer.
HINT: Refer to the table below for selection of the adjusting
washer.

SA1195
